scope: Catalog of documented M07 function-compression work and M06 reclaim screening/related consumer inventory. Not a whole-firmware search or claim that every listed routine is compressible. No new execution tests were run.
address_convention: Hexadecimal ROM offsets; intervals end-exclusive. Envelope/body span sizes may include literal data and are not free-space claims. Overlapping rows and paired estimates must not be added.

entries.name: Signed division sub_4260
entries.reason: Compresses 32 repeated ROTCL/DIV1 arithmetic pairs into a counted loop preserving the original T input at every pair.
entries.proof_scope: Compiled structural induction and 1,401 original/replacement pairs preserve final GPR/SR/PR/MAC state and divide-by-zero side effect under function-entry/private-stack/noninterleaving contracts. Nonzero path adds one private four-byte stack word; longest measured instruction count grows 79 to 210. No global stack/interrupt/timing or internal-consumer proof.

entries.name: Switch tail within sub_1466E
entries.reason: Replaces repeated nibble comparisons with a sixteen-byte lookup while retaining the enclosing function and its setup.
entries.proof_scope: Compiled structural proof covers all 16 nibble partitions and T behavior;1,792 full enclosing-function pairs pass. Requires unchanged 1466E setup R6=64; arbitrary interior entry with unconstrainedR6 has a concrete failure. No extra stack; no global entry/internal-consumer proof.

entries.name: SSM setter dispatch table representation
entries.reason: 400 pointers include 383 identical default entries. 400-byte indices + 72-byte dictionary + 92-byte helper conditionally save 1036 bytes.
entries.proof_scope: All 65,536 getter and 65,536 setter indices compared at selected-handler entry, preserving complete selected state under the helper contract; getter 400..799 alias must also translate. 16 additional private stack bytes. Unknown internal consumers/computed entries remain unresolved. Raw diagnostic ROM readback changing with image identity is not by itself a residency failure.

limitations: Scoped equivalence does not prove global caller/interior-entry/internal-data-consumer contracts.
Division adds stack traffic and instruction count; hardware preemption/timing not established.
Transparent diagnostic ROM readback is expected image-identity behavior, distinct from internal semantic consumers.
M06 table compression is frozen historical research and not selected M07 payload residency.
No new ROM/IDB/artifact/gate edits or physical actions.
